Fractions from a bag of tiles

A bag holds four tiles of the same size. Two tiles are blue, one is red, and one is green. Shake the bag before drawing a tile so each tile has the same chance of being picked.

Drawing one tile

The chance of drawing a blue tile is 24 24 .

The chance of drawing a red tile is 14 \tfrac{1}{4} . If you put the tile back and shake the bag again, the chances stay the same for the next draw.
